about.title: About the game
about.text: Parapet Classic is a non-commercial browser remake of Playman Extreme Running, the parkour game for mobile phones from 2007, made to keep the game playable and to document how it works.
about.features: Twelve levels over the rooftops of a city, with the original's missions and music, and more of our own: race your records as ghosts, share your runs as links and take on a boss on every level.
about.original.title: Original game
about.original: Playman Extreme Running (2007) was made by Mr.Goodliving and published by RealNetworks; the game, its graphics, levels and music belong to their rights holders. This project is not affiliated with them.
about.remake.title: Remake
about.remake: Remade for the browser by {name}: the code, the notes on how the original works, the new modes and art. Free and open source.

controls.title: Controls
controls.keyboard: Keyboard: arrows or WASD to run, Enter to confirm, Esc to go back, P to pause, R to start over, F for full screen
controls.gamepad: Gamepad: d-pad or left stick, Y to start over
controls.touch: Touch: left and right under one thumb, up and down under the other; between them, start over and pause
